query:
SELECT id, name, email, role, departamento, puesto 
FROM users 
WHERE email IN ('gerente.test@example.com', 'instructor.test@example.com', 'admin.test@example.com', 'committee.test@example.com', 'student.test@example.com')
ORDER BY 
  CASE role
    WHEN 'gerente' THEN 1
    WHEN 'instructor' THEN 2
    WHEN 'administrativo' THEN 3
    WHEN 'committee' THEN 4
    WHEN 'student' THEN 5
  END;
